completed.task: TD-entry GA card reconciliation — persist GA-card timestamps so polling can repair missed live transitions
completed.codex_review: Diagnosed the 'TD cards stuck in Agent Work after GA completion' issue as a mixed live/poll reconciliation bug, not a backend completion failure. The backend correctly persisted `gap_analysis_complete`, but GA cards read from Redis were serialized through `/content/briefs` without `created_at`/`updated_at`, so once the frontend locally stamped those cards from SSE, later polls could never win if the final live event was missed. Fixed by making GA Redis card metadata always carry `created_at`/`updated_at`, refreshing `updated_at` on every status-only write, and surfacing those timestamps through `DbContentDataService._load_ga_phase_cards()`. Validation: `venv/bin/pytest tests/content_engine/test_state_redis_ga.py -q` (18 passed) and `venv/bin/pytest tests/services/test_db_content_data_backend.py -k 'load_ga_phase_cards_includes_timestamps or passes_backend_not_path' -q` (2 passed).

completed.task: Company SSE Redis Streams transport — prevent XREAD heartbeat timeouts from tearing down the stream
completed.codex_review: Diagnosed repeated `/api/v1/companies/{slug}/stream` disconnects as a Redis transport bug: the company event bus blocked `XREAD` for 30s while the shared Redis client used `socket_timeout=20s`, so idle periods raised `redis.exceptions.TimeoutError` and closed the SSE stream. Fixed by capping company-stream `XREAD` block time below the Redis socket timeout and treating Redis read timeouts as heartbeat ticks instead of fatal stream errors. Validation: `venv/bin/pytest tests/events/test_company_event_bus.py -q` (17 passed).
